sentences.text: I cannot determine a prepayment penalty for your gold loans from the evidence provided because no gold-loan prepayment charge term is stated in the gold-loan FAQ. [E3]

The applicable UCB prepayment-charge rule for a Tier 3 UCB is not resolved here because the rule findings for the UCB directions are all marked UNKNOWN or DO_NOT_APPLY, including the rule that a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans with sanctioned amount/limit up to ₹50 lakh for business-purpose loans to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises. [R1,R2,R3,R4,R5,E14]
